findings.title: Total loss of the monitoring/alerting path has no independent dead-man's-switch receiver

Same residual as OBS-P0-001.

findings.title: Bad-migration recovery is manual-only with no automated reverse or staging proof

findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the deploy's container gate includes worker (and all healthchecked services) and exits 1 (deploy-do.yml:1056-1085), and the public worker probe exits 1 with logs on failure (:1155-1172).

findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: all previously unwired metrics have live call sites (API + worker), and the monitoring/SLO docs were reconciled to the wired set (OBS-P3-007).

findings.title: Incident plan's first triage step points responders at a URL that currently 404s
findings.note: new at 7dd0402: docs/INCIDENT_RESPONSE.md:57 instructs the responder to 'Confirm the signal is real: check https://api.mainecybertech.com/health, worker health, and the Prometheus/Sentry alerts' — live check on 2026-10-14 returns 404 for that URL (the same condition that keeps the external uptime probe red, OBS-P2-017), while the API actually answers under app.mainecybertech.com/api. During an incident the first verification step would fail and could be misread as an outage; the plan should point at an endpoint that works (or the endpoint/docs should be reconciled first).
